idea-plugin.name: Claude AI Assistant
idea-plugin.description:
Chat with Claude from inside Rider.
  • Tool window with conversation history
  • Send the current file or selection as context
  • Cursor position and file path are auto-attached
  • Model and API key configured in Settings → Tools → Claude AI Assistant
idea-plugin.change-notes:
0.18.1

  • Stream-end note is now always shown. A subtle gray "(end_turn)" / "(stop_sequence)" / "(tool_use)" tag confirms a response completed normally; amber "(max_tokens ...)" / "(stream ended unexpectedly ...)" still flag abnormal endings. Replies that look truncated mid-thought but were actually end_turn are now obvious instead of mysterious.

0.18.0

  • User chat bubbles get a subtle gray underlay so you can tell at a glance which text you wrote and which Claude wrote. Picks a darker tint on light themes and a lighter tint on dark themes from the transcript's actual background.
  • "Current file" attach toggle is now on by default in new chats. Toggle off if you don't want the active editor file attached to every send.

0.17.0

  • Appending to the transcript now uses HTMLEditorKit.insertHTML at the document tail instead of rewriting the entire JTextPane content on every append. Fixes the "after a long reply, new messages stop showing" problem - that was a re-parse stall on the growing HTML, not an event-handling bug.
  • When a stream closes without a stop_reason (transient network blip, server-side cutoff), the transcript now shows a small amber "(stream ended unexpectedly...)" note instead of leaving you guessing.
  • New brain icon for the tool window stripe button.
  • Welcome message shortened to "Hi! I'm here to help."

0.16.0

  • Markdown rendering: bold (**text**), italic (*text* / _text_), headings (#, ##, ###), bullet lists (-, *), numbered lists (1.), inline code (`), fenced code blocks (```). Previously only code was styled.
  • Pasted images now show in the user bubble as a real preview thumbnail. We write the thumbnail to a temp file and reference it via file:// in the transcript HTML, because JTextPane's HTML loader doesn't reliably resolve data: URIs.
  • On stream error mid-response, whatever partial text arrived before the failure is now preserved as the assistant turn (with the error message appended in red), instead of being dropped.

0.15.0

  • When a streaming response ends abnormally (anything other than the normal "end_turn"), the transcript now shows a small amber note explaining why - typically "max_tokens" (response was truncated because the per-message token cap was hit) or "refusal" (the model declined). For max_tokens it links to the Max tokens setting.
